I added `GET /api/v1/items/stats`. I haven't run the tests, the app or Ruff, as you asked.

It returns `{"count": n, "newest_title": str | null}`. Regular users get numbers for their own items. Superusers get numbers across all items.

- **Route:** `read_item_stats` in `backend/app/api/routes/items.py`. I put it above `/{id}` so "stats" isn't parsed as an item id.
- **Query logic:** it lives in a new `get_item_stats` in `backend/app/crud.py`. `backend/app/CLAUDE.md` says route handlers must not call session methods. It takes `owner_id`, and `None` means all items.
- **Response schema:** a new `ItemStats` model in `backend/app/models.py`.
- **Newest item:** the newest is picked by `created_at` descending, with `id` descending as a tie-breaker so the result is deterministic.

I didn't regenerate the frontend API client, so the new endpoint is missing from it. Run `bash scripts/generate-client.sh` to update it. I also didn't add tests.
